_doc: Commands that MUST exist on PATH after `build.sh switch`. The post-switch verifier in build.sh checks each and prints WARN/FAIL lines for any that are missing or broken. Add new entries when introducing tools that need to survive every rebuild.

commands.name: claude
commands.fix: Re-run: nix-on-droid switch --flake $HOME/git/unix/bb_flakes_termux/src; if npm install fails (OOM/SIGTERM), retry build.sh switch — the npm activation hook is idempotent.

commands.name: claude-malloc
commands.fix: Wrapper installed by flake.nix:claude-malloc; verify the closure built. Run build.sh dry-run to inspect.

commands.name: claude-rescue
commands.fix: Wrapper installed by flake.nix:claude-rescue. Same as claude-malloc.

commands.name: claude-termux
commands.fix: Wrapper installed by flake.nix:claude-termux. Same as claude-malloc.

commands.name: termux-sshd
commands.fix: Installed by sshd.nix via home.file. If missing, the flake didn't activate — re-run build.sh switch.

commands.name: sshd
commands.fix: Installed by sshd.nix via home.packages = [ opensshPinned ]. If missing, openssh-pinned didn't build — check build.log for openssh-pinned-8.9p1 errors.

commands.name: node
commands.fix: Installed by flake.nix:environment.packages = [ nodejs_22 ]. Required for claude.
